severity_assessment: HIGH owner-required workflow gap; not a security exploit or fraudulent accounting claim.

evidence.evidence: Primary cart action label is payment in both layouts.
Pickup identity validation then common tender screen; no persisted kitchen-first operation here.
Pickup save validates/normalizes local customer/schedule state and closes editor only; no API order creation.
Common checkout request combines items, tender, pickup metadata and receipt route in one dispatch; this path does not expose stage-A prepare-only identity.

preconditions: Owner requires branch pickup preparation/kitchen ticket before later payment on same persisted order.
counterevidence: This independently challenged scope is active client entry paths, not a proof every backend endpoint lacks possible building blocks.
Electronic pending can defer confirmation and automatic preparation can be held by setting, but is a different payment claim workflow from explicit preparation-first pickup.
Unseen alternative app/workflow cannot be ruled out by these client spans alone.
recommended_remediation: Specify and validate explicit persisted pickup preparation/payment lifecycle using existing backend capabilities where suitable; architecture-wide implementation plan requires completed backend synthesis.
required_tests: Trace stage-A persisted order ID/no payment and stage-B same-ID payment; kitchen ticket exactly once and final receipt after money.
Evaluate all pickup UI entry points and backend state transitions before declaring global architecture absence.
method: Independent source-only challenge; no application or service execution
